top_signal.title: Switching from 3 programs to one program
top_signal.summary: Hey Everyone -   Breakdown   I am currently using a Scheduling Program, POS program and an Email marketing program - 3 different platforms.   I am thinking of moving to  mangomint .    I am really struggling with this aspect of my business. I am using  Setmore for booking  which is great yet that is all it is, a booking program.    Setmore is integrated to  Squareup for POS  - but it does not sync completely with Squareup so when I get monthly Squareup reports, lots of items are Uncategorized. I have told Setmore this.    I also have an  email marketing program, Mailerlite , and it too integrates with Setmore, but I am really bad at it and don't do it. I lost the person I hired to help me, but they had to stop working with me due to family stuff.    Also, Squareup tracks your location whenever you use it, which means I can be at home using it for messages and I don't find that necessary, weird.   Last, the I have been having a hard time connecting my Squareup reader (tap to pay) to my phones. Granted I have 2 different scheduling programs connected to the same Squareup acct. so I wonder if that is the issue.    I am thinking of switching to  mangomint.  Has anyone used this program. One of the things I learned is that you can custom time schedule clients, which would be huge for me. It also has email marketing for a small fee and it has it's POS system. I would do everything under one roof.   The problem is that it is expensive. I currently pay $22/month for Setmore and Squar
